$comment: Reviewed 2026.1 scene scope from the pinned server protocol truth table and honua-flow quality contract. Counts and editions are always synced from the server matrix, never overridden here. The 3D Tiles summary corrects a stale generated key description using the pinned route table.

serve.i3s-scene.scopeNote: Experimental in 2026.1, opt-in and excluded from GA compatibility and SLA. Enterprise metadata preview only; production does not advertise renderable geometry. Unlicensed requests return HTTP 402. Hosted I3S candidate data and a live scene endpoint remain deferred to 2026.2.

serve.3d-tiles-scene.scopeNote: Experimental in 2026.1, opt-in and excluded from GA compatibility and SLA. Source-backed hosted-tree serving does not establish a governed client or candidate-qualified live demo. Hosted candidate data and broader rendering qualification remain deferred to 2026.2.
serve.3d-tiles-scene.summary: Serve registered 3D Tiles at /scenes/{sceneId}/tileset.json and asset routes. Enterprise scene ingest is gated separately.

scene.catalog.scopeNote: Experimental in 2026.1, opt-in and excluded from GA compatibility and SLA. Discovery routes are source-backed; cross-SDK scene wire qualification remains deferred to 2026.2.

scene.bim-ingest.scopeNote: Experimental in 2026.1, opt-in and excluded from GA compatibility and SLA. Enterprise CityGML ingest is a separate capability from Community scene serving; no general BIM or SLPK import claim is made.

scene.pointcloud-ingest.scopeNote: Experimental in 2026.1, opt-in and excluded from GA compatibility and SLA. Enterprise scene ingest is separate from GA pcloud.translate. LAZ/COPC and projected input require a configured worker; without one, these requests return HTTP 400.

serve.elevation.scopeNote: This is the independent server elevation profile/value analysis surface. Its proving-test count does not qualify a 3D scene renderer or Cesium terrain service.

raster.terrain-rgb.scopeNote: The Maui demo shows MapLibre 2.5D building extrusions and raster terrain. It does not prove I3S geometry, 3D Tiles hosting, or Cesium quantized-mesh terrain. The 3D terrain release promise remains Experimental in 2026.1, outside GA compatibility and SLA.
